title: Senior Data Engineering Associate
description: Transform data into actionable insights within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, building scalable data pipelines and cloud warehouses.
details:
### Role Overview
As a Senior Data Engineering Associate, you will play a pivotal role transforming data into actionable insights within our Data Modernisation practice. You will leverage cloud-native platforms to design, develop, and implement enterprise data solutions.

### Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain data pipelines using Informatica PowerCenter and cloud-native ETL tools.
- Implement database optimization techniques on AWS, Azure, and Snowflake data platforms.
- Design and manage data warehouses and data lakes to facilitate efficient data storage and retrieval.
- Conduct data validation, quality checks, and performance tuning.

### Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in CS, IT, or related quantitative field.
- 4+ years of hands-on experience in ETL/ELT development and cloud data engineering.
